items.question: How many government schools introduced the Ajyal Schools model in the academic year 2022-2023 in the UAE?
items.gold: Ajyal Schools was introduced in 10 government schools in the academic year 2022-2023.
items.fact: Ajyal Schools launched in 10 government schools in 2022-2023.

items.question: Which grade levels does the Ajyal Schools model in the UAE accept students from?
items.fact: Ajyal Schools accept students from grade one through grade four.
